title: Quartiles and outlier fences using Excel's inclusive convention
scenario_markdown: Nine observed call-handling times are 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 30 minutes. Use Excel QUARTILE.INC, defined by zero-based position (n-1)p with linear interpolation, and the 1.5 IQR outlier rule. The course's required quartile convention is still unconfirmed.
assumptions: Use QUARTILE.INC rather than QUARTILE.EXC or a median-of-halves method.
An outlier flag is a diagnostic, not permission to remove an observation.

stages.prompt_markdown: What is Q1 in minutes under the stated inclusive convention? Select the value rounded to four decimal places.

options.hint_markdown: A median-of-halves convention can produce a different value; use (n-1)*0.25.
The median is Q2, not Q1.

stages.explanation_markdown: Position $(9-1)(0.25)=2$ is the third ordered observation, 4 minutes. Excel: `=QUARTILE.INC(A2:A10,1)`.

stages.prompt_markdown: What is Q3 in minutes? Select the value rounded to four decimal places.

options.hint_markdown: Use the stated inclusive position, not an exclusive convention.
Q3 is the 75th percentile, not the maximum.

stages.explanation_markdown: Position $(9-1)(0.75)=6$ is the seventh ordered observation, 8 minutes. Excel: `=QUARTILE.INC(A2:A10,3)`.

stages.prompt_markdown: What is the upper 1.5 IQR fence in minutes? Select the value rounded to four decimal places.

options.hint_markdown: Add 1.5 times IQR to Q3, not just IQR.
Use Q3 as the upper-fence anchor rather than Q1.

stages.explanation_markdown: $IQR=8-4=4$; upper fence $=8+1.5(4)=14$. The lower fence is $4-6=-2$. Excel: `=Q3+1.5*(Q3-Q1)`.

stages.prompt_markdown: Which observation is flagged, and what should happen next?

options.text_markdown: 30 minutes is above 14; investigate its context and accuracy before deciding how to handle it.
Every observation above Q3 must be deleted.
options.hint_markdown: The upper quartile is not the upper outlier fence.

options.text_markdown: 30 minutes must be a recording error because it is flagged.
options.hint_markdown: Unusual observations can be valid; the fence does not establish their cause.

stages.explanation_markdown: Only 30 lies outside [-2,14]. Investigate data quality and operational circumstances, and document any handling decision. Quartile conventions can affect fences, so the chosen method must be stated.
